title: Subagent model routing honours agent frontmatter and explicit model overrides
body:
Why: Fable audit 1114f (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-audit-1114f.md) fix 3: krn-reader pinned haiku ran Sonnet 39/55 (env CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL beats frontmatter); scripts/claude/subagent-model.ts:31 reroutes general-purpose to krn-lane before checking model (6 Fable runs landed in the lane prompt).
Outcome: the hook fills model from the agent frontmatter when the call has none; a call with an explicit model is not rerouted.
Proof: unit tests on captured PreToolUse Agent payloads.
